Name: (CP) Mayor Lewis in Shipping Bin
Author: SchrodingersKit
Description:
[font=Tahoma][size=4][b]Updated for 1.6![/b][/size]

Remember how Lewis said he would pick up your items from the shipping bin? With this mod, he'll pop out of the bin and take your item to ship right there!

~~

Inspired by the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/65]JG Demetrius in Shipping Box mod[/url], this mod adds Lewis into your shipping bin. When you ship an item, he'll pop out and back inside. Purely cosmetic and for fun; rest assured that your products and profits are entirely safe.

Works with buildable shipping bins around the farm, and overlays over other shipping bin colors--like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1554]Eemie's Dark Wood[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1904]my Burnt Sienna[/url]~

Note however that this mod does [b]not [/b]work with anything that affects the shipping bin animation itself--such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/518]Chests Anywhere[/url]﻿. 

[b]To install--[/b]
[b]1.[/b] Install the latest versions of [url=https://canimod.com/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
[b]2. [/b]Unzip and paste into your 'Mods' folder.
[b]3. [/b]Load up your game and say hi to the good mayor in your bin!

Check out some other fun character-in-shipping-bin mods here!

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/65]JG Demetrius in Shipping Box mod (the one that started it all~)[/url]﻿
